sys_ux_event.description: Fires when any action bar button, split-button half or menu item is activated. Branch on `id` (and `itemId` for menu items) to run the right logic. Payload: { id, label, type, source, itemId, itemLabel, table, sysId, record, data }.
sys_ux_event.label: Action clicked
sys_ux_event.props: [ { "description": "The `id` of the clicked action, as configured in Actions.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "Action id", "name": "id", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "Display label of the clicked action.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "Action label", "name": "label", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "button, icon, split or menu.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "Action type", "name": "type", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "Where the click came from: button, split-primary, menu-item or overflow.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "Source", "name": "source", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "For a split-button or menu item, the `id` of that item; empty for a top-level action.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "Item id", "name": "itemId", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "Label of the clicked sub-item, if any.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "Item label", "name": "itemLabel", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "Table of the current record.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "Table", "name": "table", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "sys_id of the current record.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "Record Sys ID", "name": "sysId", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "The loaded record, so a handler has full context without re-querying.", "fieldType": "json", "label": "Record", "name": "record", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "The action's optional `data` object, passed straight through from the Actions configuration.", "fieldType": "json", "label": "Custom data", "name": "data", "valueType": "string" } ]
